description.value: Penang Szechuan Cuisine Restaurant is a Szechuan Chinese restaurant in White Rock praised by reviewers for bold, authentic flavors including kung pao chicken, mapo tofu, dan dan noodles, and spicy fish fillet. It offers dine-in with a cozy atmosphere as well as online ordering and takeout, making it a practical meal stop for cyclists exploring the South Surrey and White Rock waterfront area.
